# sendgrid_teammate (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing SendGrid teammate, or pending teammate invite, by email address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_teammate" "analyst" {
  email = "analyst@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The teammate's email address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `email`.
- `is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the teammate has admin privileges.
- `scopes` (Set of String) The permission scopes granted to the teammate.
- `status` (String) Either `pending` (invite sent, not yet accepted) or `accepted`.
- `username` (String) The teammate's username, once they have accepted the invite. Empty while pending.
